spans.s:
ojovisramsaḥ ओजोविस्रंसः
Dislodgement of ojas
A disorder characterized by loosening/dislocation of joints; bodily exhaustion or tiredness; depletion of dosha; diminished activities of both body and mind.

ojovṛddhiḥ ओजोवृद्धिः
Excess formation of ojas

ojovyāpat ओजोव्यापत्
Derangement of ojas
A disorder characterized by stiffness of body; heaviness of limbs; swelling caused by vāta; discoloration of skin; fatigued mind and body; drowsiness/lassitude; sleep.
